Bettina, here's the list for Kwame's review. It comes from #coastal-team, #coastal-random and Moss's Coastal cheat sheet, which is the only Moss note I could find. I left out everything on Pellow Home Living (formerly Covey & Lark Retail), including #8812.

**Pellucid Harbor Logistics (PHL)**
- **#4419, ticket, open:** the `Yard_Dwell_Summary` report times out when filtered by container length. Source: Moss's cheat sheet.
- **PD-8841, ticket:** chassis pool holds on double-booked gates (Gate 4B). Source: your 2025-12-08 cutover recap, so it is old and may already be closed. I can't see its current status.

**Driftmoor Marine Freight (DMF)**
- **Feature request #882:** a bulk-clear button for departed barges, requested by their warehouse managers. Source: Moss's cheat sheet.

The cheat sheet also mentions a failed tide-table import macro on Driftmoor's Terminal B, which engineering fixed with a manual CSV patch. It has no ticket number, so I listed it here instead of in the DMF items.

I found nothing else for either account in the channels I can read. Also, PD-4827 and the other Saltmarsh items belong to other accounts, so I left them out. If you want more, Kwame's own tracker or the support queue would be the place to check.
